mapper.select: SELECT SETTLEMENT_ID as settlementId, ORG_CODE as orgCode, ORG_NAME as orgName, PERIOD_SCHEME as periodScheme, ACCOUNTING_PERIOD as accountingPeriod, SETTLEMENT_STATUS as settlementStatus, SETTLEMENT_USER_NAME as settlementUserName, SETTLEMENT_TIME as settlementTime, CANCEL_USER_NAME as cancelUserName, CANCEL_TIME as cancelTime, CREATE_TIME as createTime FROM T_REVENUE_BATCH_SETTLEMENT WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND SETTLEMENT_ID = #{settlementId}
